name: Ner (Kish's father, great-grandfather to King Saul (according to 1 Chron 8:33))
title: Great-grandfather to King Saul
summary: Ner was a man from the tribe of Benjamin and the father of Kish, who in turn was the father of Israel's first king, Saul. He is mentioned in the genealogies in 1 Chronicles as an important part of the Benjamite lineage that led to the monarchy. His role in the Bible is primarily genealogical, but he is significant as an ancestor of the first Israelite royal house.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Benjamin's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Ner is listed in the genealogy of Benjamin's descendants as the father of Kish and thus an ancestor of King Saul.

keyEvents.title: Connection to Saul's Royal Line
keyEvents.description: Through his son Kish, Ner became the forefather of Israel's first royal dynasty. Saul, his grandson, was anointed king by the prophet Samuel.

keyEvents.title: Connection to Abner
keyEvents.description: According to several biblical texts, Abner, Saul's military commander, was the son of Ner, making Abner a close relative of King Saul. Some texts describe Ner directly as Abner's father.

keyEvents.title: Part of the inheritance of the tribe of Benjamin
keyEvents.description: Ner belonged to the tribe of Benjamin, the smallest of the tribes of Israel, which nevertheless had the honor of producing Israel's first king.
